An id with no stored basket reads as the empty basket; nothing is written until the first mutation (a `GET` never creates a file entry). `toResponse(id, stored)` keeps stored order, awaits `catalog.findProduct` per line (`?? null`) and reduces totals over lines with a product: `count += quantity`, `sum += product.price * quantity` — integer UAH, never rounded. *Alternatives:* throwing `NotFoundError` from lib and catching in the route — control flow moves into the handler, and typed results are already the project's convention (adapters). 4. **Route** (`apps/api/src/routes/basket.ts`): `basketRoutes(service)` = `new Hono<{ Variables: { basketId: string } }>()`. Middleware `app.use("*", …)`: `const parsed = BasketIdSchema.safeParse(getCookie(c, "basket_id")); const id = parsed.success ? parsed.data : randomUUID();` when not parsed → `setCookie(c, "basket_id", id, { httpOnly: true, path: "/", sameSite: "Lax", maxAge: 60 * 60 * 24 * 30 })`; `c.set("basketId", id); await next()`. Handlers stay three lines: parse (`await c.req.json().catch(() => undefined)` → `AddBasketItemSchema` / `UpdateBasketItemSchema` `.safeParse` → `c.json({ error: "Invalid request body" }, 400)`; `ProductIdSchema.safeParse(c.req.param("productId"))` → `c.json({ error: "Invalid product id" }, 400)`, param before body), one service call, then `c.json(result.basket, 201)` (POST) / `c.json(basket, 200)` / `c.json({ error: result.error }, 404)`. The middleware also runs on 400 / 404 answers, so a first visit always gets its cookie. `secure` is not set: dev is http on localhost; a TLS deployment adds `secure: true` in this one place. *Alternatives:* `setSignedCookie` — needs a secret in config and the owner decided on a plain UUID; an `X-Basket-Id` header — not a cookie, would not survive a reload without client code. 5. **App wiring**: `createApp({ catalog, basketStore, now = Date.now }: AppDeps)` builds the service and mounts `app.route("/api/basket", basketRoutes(service))` next to the products router. `config.ts`: `dataDir: env.DATA_DIR ?? resolve(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "../../../.data")` (same technique as `snapshotDir`). `server.ts`: `createBasketStore(join(config.dataDir, "baskets.json"))`. The `add-catalog` tests `app.test.ts` and `routes/products.test.ts` gain `basketStore: createBasketStore(join(mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), "baskets-")), "baskets.json"))`. *Alternative:* an optional `basketStore` with an in-memory default — would hide a missing wiring in production; rejected. 6. **Web state** (`apps/web/src/basket/BasketContext.tsx`): `BasketProvider` + `useBasket()`. State `{ status: "loading" } | { status: "error" } | { status: "ready"; basket: BasketResponse }`; the provider calls `getBasket()` once in a mount-only `useEffect` (`try { setReady(await getBasket()) } catch { setError() }`), exposes `setBasket(basket)` so whoever receives a fresh basket from a mutation stores it, and derives `count = status === "ready" ? basket.totals.count : 0`. `App` renders `

      Organic Catalog

      Кошик ({count})
      `. *Alternatives:* a callback prop from `App` to the cards — the data router builds the tree outside React, there is no prop path; a store library — new dependency; re-fetching `getBasket()` after every mutation — one extra request per click for data the response already carries (the owner's "refreshes after every mutation" is met either way; the spec pins "without a second `getBasket()` call"). 7. **Product card button** (`ProductCard.tsx`): `` with local state `"idle" | "pending" | "added" | "failed"`; click → `setBasket(await addToBasket(product.id, 1))` → `"added"` renders `Додано`; a rejection renders `Не вдалося додати` (**assumption** — the owner's list stops at the success text; a card must say something when the call fails; no spec scenario, one extra test is welcome). The button stays enabled after success (quantities merge server-side), and no `role="status"` element exists before a click, so add-catalog's "no `role="status"`" assertions still hold. 8. **Basket page** (`apps/web/src/pages/BasketPage.tsx`; `router.tsx` adds `{ path: "basket", Component: BasketPage }` as a child of `App`): renders from the provider state — `loading` → `

      Кошик

      ` + `

      Завантажуємо кошик…

      `; `error` → `

      Не вдалося завантажити кошик

      ` (both **assumptions**, same reasoning as D7); `ready` with no lines → `

      Кошик порожній

      ` + `До каталогу`; `ready` with lines → `
        ` of `BasketLine`, `

        Разом: {formatPrice(totals.sum)}

        `, `` → `setBasket(await clearBasket())`. `formatPrice` is imported from `ProductCard.tsx`, not duplicated. 9. **Basket line** (`apps/web/src/components/BasketLine.tsx`, an `
      • `): product present → ``, name, unit, `formatPrice(price)`, ``, `formatPrice(price * quantity)`, ``; product `null` → `Товар недоступний` in place of image / name / unit / prices, input and button kept. The input keeps a local text state (`useState(String(quantity))`, reset by `key={`${productId}:${quantity}`}` on the `
      • `); `onChange` → `const n = Number(value)`; if `Number.isInteger(n) && n >= 1 && n <= 99` → `setBasket(await updateBasketItem(productId, n))`, otherwise the typed text stays local and nothing is sent (lets the buyer clear the field before typing). "Видалити" → `setBasket(await removeBasketItem(productId))`. A rejected mutation leaves the last known basket on screen (**assumption**). *Alternatives:* `onBlur` only — the owner said "change calls `updateBasketItem`" and `fireEvent.change` is the natural test; debouncing — premature for a number input. 10. **Client** (`client.ts`): one private `request(method, path, body?)` → `fetch(path, { method, credentials: "same-origin", headers: body ? { "Content-Type": "application/json" } : undefined, body: body ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined })`; `!res.ok` → `throw new Error(`${method} ${path} failed: ${res.status}`)`; otherwise `BasketResponseSchema.parse(await res.json())`. `getBasket = () => request("GET", "/api/basket")`, `addToBasket = (productId, quantity) => request("POST", "/api/basket/items", { productId, quantity })`, `updateBasketItem = (productId, quantity) => request("PATCH", `/api/basket/items/${productId}`, { quantity })`, `removeBasketItem = (productId) => request("DELETE", `/api/basket/items/${productId}`)`, `clearBasket = () => request("DELETE", "/api/basket")`. `getProducts` is untouched. Product ids contain `:` only, which needs no encoding in a path segment, so the paths read exactly as in the spec. ## File layout ``` packages/shared/src/index.ts + basket schemas and types (D1) apps/api/src/config.ts (+ config.test.ts) + dataDir / DATA_DIR (D5) apps/api/src/lib/store/baskets.ts (+ .test.ts) createBasketStore(filePath): get, update — atomic JSON file (D2) apps/api/src/lib/basket.ts createBasketService({ store, catalog, now }), BasketResult (D3; covered by the route tests) apps/api/src/routes/basket.ts (+ .test.ts) basketRoutes(service): cookie middleware + five handlers (D4) apps/api/src/app.ts / app.test.ts / server.ts createApp({ catalog, basketStore, now }); store wired from config.dataDir (D5) apps/api/src/routes/products.test.ts passes a temp basketStore (signature change only) apps/web/src/api/client.ts (+ client.test.ts) + getBasket, addToBasket, updateBasketItem, removeBasketItem, clearBasket (D10) apps/web/src/basket/BasketContext.tsx BasketProvider, useBasket (D6; covered by App / page tests) apps/web/src/App.tsx (+ App.test.tsx) provider + header link "Кошик (N)" (D6) apps/web/src/components/ProductCard.tsx (+ .test) + "Додати в кошик" / "Додано" (D7) apps/web/src/components/BasketLine.tsx one
      • of the basket page (D9; covered by BasketPage tests) apps/web/src/pages/BasketPage.tsx (+ .test.tsx) route /basket (D8) apps/web/src/router.tsx + { path: "basket", Component: BasketPage } apps/web/src/pages/CatalogPage.test.tsx setup only: getBasket mocked with a resolved empty basket ``` ## Risks / Trade-offs - [Unsigned UUID cookie] → whoever knows an id can read or alter that basket. Accepted for an anonymous basket that holds no personal data: ids are 122 random bits, not guessable; `add-admin` signs its own session cookie. If it ever matters, `setSignedCookie` with a secret from config touches only the middleware. - [No `Secure` attribute] → by design for http on localhost; a TLS deployment sets `secure: true` in D4. - [One JSON file, whole-file rewrite] → O(baskets) per write — fine for a capstone; the in-process queue prevents lost updates, but two API processes on one file would race (Non-Goal, documented). - [Corrupt `baskets.json`] → the store throws, `/api/basket` answers 500 until a human fixes or deletes the file; chosen over silently starting from an empty file. - [`findProduct` per line calls `load()`] → cached 5 minutes in live mode, memoized snapshots in snapshot mode (add-catalog D4 / D5), so a 10-line basket costs no extra shop requests; batching through one `load()` would change the catalog API — not now. - [`createApp` signature and the header fetch touch add-catalog tests] → three setup-only edits (D5, D6), listed as explicit tasks so the red run stays attributable to the new scenarios. - [Quantity input UX] → typing `0` or clearing the field sends nothing, and the server rejects out-of-range values with 400, so the page can never show an invalid quantity coming from the server. - [32 scenarios → 32 tests] → helpers (fake catalog built from `data/shops/*.json`, temp-store factory, a request builder that sets the `Cookie` header) live in the test files, not in `src/`. ## Open Questions None that would change the specs, the approach or the task breakdown.

### setCookie(c, name, value, opt?)

Source: https://hono.dev/docs/helpers/cookie

Sets a regular HTTP cookie in the response context with optional configuration properties.

```APIDOC
### setCookie(c, name, value, opt?)

Sets a standard cookie on the response.

#### Parameters
- `c` (Context) - Required. The Hono context object.
- `name` (string) - Required. The name of the cookie.
- `value` (string) - Required. The value of the cookie.
- `opt` (CookieOptions) - Optional. Cookie configuration options:
  - `domain` (string) - Domain for the cookie.
  - `expires` (Date) - Expiration date of the cookie.
  - `httpOnly` (boolean) - Flags the cookie as accessible only via HTTP(S).
  - `maxAge` (number) - Number of seconds until the cookie expires.
  - `path` (string) - Path that must exist in the requested URL.
  - `secure` (boolean) - Marks the cookie to be sent over HTTPS only.
  - `sameSite` ('Strict' | 'Lax' | 'None') - Controls whether the cookie is sent with cross-site requests.
  - `priority` ('Low' | 'Medium' | 'High') - Priority of the cookie.
  - `prefix` ('secure' | 'host') - Cookie name prefix.
  - `partitioned` (boolean) - Partitioned cookie (CHIPS) flag.

#### Example
```ts
import { setCookie } from 'hono/cookie'

app.get('/cookie', (c) => {
  setCookie(c, 'great_cookie', 'banana', {
    path: '/',
    secure: true,
    domain: 'example.com',
    httpOnly: true,
    maxAge: 1000,
    expires: new Date(Date.UTC(2000, 11, 24, 10, 30, 59, 900)),
    sameSite: 'Strict',
  })
})
```
```

--------------------------------

### app.request(path, options?)

Source: https://hono.dev/docs/api/hono

Sends a mock request directly to the Hono instance and returns a Response object. Useful for unit and integration testing without binding to a network port.

```APIDOC
## app.request(path, options?)

### Description
A helper method primarily used for testing. Sends a request to the app and returns a standard `Response` object.

### Syntax
```ts
app.request(path, options?): Promise<Response>
app.request(request): Promise<Response>
```

### Parameters
- **path | request** (string | Request) - Required. A URL string / pathname (defaults to GET) or a full `Request` instance.
- **options** (RequestInit, optional) - Optional fetch options when passing a path string.

### Example
```ts
test('GET /hello is ok', async () => {
  const res = await app.request('/hello')
  expect(res.status).toBe(200)
})

test('POST /message is ok', async () => {
  const req = new Request('http://localhost/message', {
    method: 'POST',
  })
  const res = await app.request(req)
  expect(res.status).toBe(201)
})
```
```

--------------------------------

### Configure options for setCookie and setSignedCookie

Source: https://hono.dev/docs/helpers/cookie

Pass cookie configuration options such as path, secure, domain, httpOnly, maxAge, expires, and sameSite when setting regular or signed cookies.

```typescript
// Regular cookies
setCookie(c, 'great_cookie', 'banana', {
  path: '/',
  secure: true,
  domain: 'example.com',
  httpOnly: true,
  maxAge: 1000,
  expires: new Date(Date.UTC(2000, 11, 24, 10, 30, 59, 900)),
  sameSite: 'Strict',
})

// Signed cookies
await setSignedCookie(
  c,
  'fortune_cookie',
  'lots-of-money',
  'secret ingredient',
  {
    path: '/',
    secure: true,
    domain: 'example.com',
    httpOnly: true,
    maxAge: 1000,
    expires: new Date(Date.UTC(2000, 11, 24, 10, 30, 59, 900)),
    sameSite: 'Strict',
  }
)
```

--------------------------------

### Using the Cookie helper with getCookie and setCookie

Source: https://hono.dev/docs/guides/helpers

Demonstrates reading and setting HTTP cookies inside a route handler using getCookie and setCookie from hono/cookie.

```ts
import { getCookie, setCookie } from 'hono/cookie'

const app = new Hono()

app.get('/cookie', (c) => {
  const yummyCookie = getCookie(c, 'yummy_cookie')
  // ...
  setCookie(c, 'delicious_cookie', 'macha')
  //
})
```

### Cookie Helper > Options > `setCookie` & `setSignedCookie`

Source: https://hono.dev/docs/helpers/cookie

* domain: `string`
  * expires: `Date`
  * httpOnly: `boolean`
  * maxAge: `number`
  * path: `string`
  * secure: `boolean`
  * sameSite: `'Strict'` | `'Lax'` | `'None'`
  * priority: `'Low' | 'Medium' | 'High'`
  * prefix: `secure` | `'host'`
  * partitioned: `boolean`

assumptions: Cookie validity: a basket_id cookie is valid when its value parses as a UUID (BasketIdSchema = z.uuid()); a missing or malformed value gets a fresh crypto.randomUUID() and the Set-Cookie header; a well-formed UUID unknown to the store is reused as an empty basket (nothing is written until the first mutation).

400 messages are fixed strings so tests can assert them exactly: body failures → { error: "Invalid request body" }, path-param failures → { error: "Invalid product id" }; a product id is valid when it matches <shopKey>:<sourceId> (ProductIdSchema), so a malformed id is 400 and a well-formed unknown id is 404.

Baskets file shape (design decides): { baskets: { <uuid>: { updatedAt, items: [ { productId, quantity, addedAt } ] } } }; lines are returned in insertion order; addedAt is kept from the first add when quantities merge; clear writes an empty basket; a file that exists but fails BasketsFileSchema throws (500) rather than silently discarding baskets; writes are serialized through an in-process promise queue.

Web state: a React context (BasketProvider in App.tsx, useBasket()) holds one basket object; getBasket() is called once on mount and every mutation stores the basket the client call returns (no second getBasket), which satisfies 'refreshes after every mutation'.

UI states not in the owner's list, recorded in design.md only (no spec scenarios): /basket shows role="status" 'Завантажуємо кошик…' while loading and 'Не вдалося завантажити кошик' on error; a failed 'Додати в кошик' shows role="status" 'Не вдалося додати'; a rejected page mutation leaves the last known basket on screen; the quantity input sends updateBasketItem only for integers 1..99 and keeps other typed text local.
An unavailable line (product null) replaces image/name/unit/prices with 'Товар недоступний' but keeps the 'Кількість' input and 'Видалити' button so the buyer can drop it.
The 'Кошик' heading on /basket is level 2 because the layout's h1 'Organic Catalog' from add-catalog stays on every route.

The catalog-web delta is ADDED-only and has no ## Purpose (the capability belongs to add-catalog); strict validate accepts it. Surfaced conflict: add-catalog's requirement text 'no basket controls' becomes stale — the human should drop that phrase when add-catalog is archived or via a later MODIFIED delta; its scenarios still hold because the button renders no role="status" element until clicked.

createApp's signature becomes createApp({ catalog, basketStore, now = Date.now }); add-catalog's app.test.ts and products.test.ts must pass a temp-directory basket store (task 5.2), and CatalogPage.test.tsx/App.test.tsx must give the mocked getBasket a resolved value (tasks 1.7, 6.2) because the layout now calls it on mount.
